title: Traveler Profile
intro: Couple, relaxed-cultural pace, 14 days China → Vietnam. Value-conscious in China, splurge in Vietnam. App-based transit only (DiDi/Grab); no street taxis.

tables.caption: Budget
rows: Splurge in Vietnam; value-conscious in China

bullets.heading: Interests (ranked)
items: History — cultural sites, not museum marathons

bullets.heading: Style & Pace
items: Late mornings; avoid long transit days
Ideal day: brunch → beach walk → dusk city views

bullets.heading: Accommodation
items: 4–5 star hotels; resorts preferred in Vietnam
Must be bookable on US platforms

callouts.text: Large crowds — avoid peak hours, book early-entry tickets
Heat — schedule outdoor activity for early morning / late afternoon
Both travelers in excellent physical condition — no mobility limits
